original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 Log Header Start Offset identifies the approved header location within the System Event Log area, correctly represents a no-header implementation when documented, is consistent with data start/area length and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture the complete Type 15 layout, preserve the raw header offset and related area/data offsets, access method, header format and status, validate bounds and no-header semantics against the platform design, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the header-offset/no-header layout and reboot plan. Log clearing, writes and event injection are excluded.
required_inputs: Expected raw/decoded Log Header Start Offset
Expected Log Area Length and Log Data Start Offset
Documented no-header encoding and header-format expectations
Access method/status and platform log implementation map
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Snapshot logs read-only; do not perform the generic source log clearing or any write/injection.
Preserve the raw offset and validate it against Log Area Length and Data Start Offset; text equality alone is insufficient.
Do not treat zero as invalid or valid without the approved no-header/layout rule.
Do not infer BMC SEL header location unless the platform explicitly maps Type 15 to that store.
Stop on out-of-bounds/overlap, format inconsistency, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect the complete Type 15 layout, validate header offset/no-header state and cross-field bounds, and compare pre/post reboot.
Do not clear/write logs, inject events or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve header/no-header and access-method layout expectations.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve any implementation-specific zero value and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The selected field is relevant, but the grep fragment omits raw value, area/data bounds, header format and no-header semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 15 records and validate the header offset with area length, data start, header format, access method and documented no-header rule.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Log Header Start Offset scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; generic log clearing is excluded by the locked safety rule.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare raw header offset to the complete approved layout, explicitly distinguish a documented absent-header representation from a real header location and calculate nonoverlap/bounds across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 System Event Log implementations.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, event-log implementation and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 header offset/header format semantics, approved platform log layout and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw/cross-field bounds and no-header interpretation while preserving the field target.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects overlap/out-of-range and avoids false failure on an approved no-header design.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Complete header/data/area layout and no-header policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Static offset metadata does not prove log header contents are readable or correct; that requires a separately authorized access test.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a zero/no-header layout or a changed offset for a firmware design, but must version the full area/data/header-format relationship and cannot clear logs to force consistency.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, header/no-header policy and full Type 15 layout
Complete pre-reboot Type 15 record with raw/decoded header offset, area/data offsets, header format, access method and status
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot metadata diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The offset field is unambiguous; the unsafe generic clear-logs preparation is nonessential and excluded by higher-priority evidence-preservation policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The offset/layout is safely readable; missing layout or zero-value policy is readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw/cross-field bounds, no-header semantics and evidence preservation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains layout and no-write safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates project layout/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents zero or a plausible offset from being judged without its header-format and area/data layout context, while protecting existing logs.
independent_technical_reasoning: Header offset is structured numeric metadata; approved no-header interpretation, bounds and persistence are deterministic software checks.
